examples: A senior-note Amount under the May 31 comparative debt table was marked annual although it is an outstanding balance at the reporting date.
Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of period was marked annual although the row denotes a point-in-time opening balance.
Cash, cash equivalents and trade receivables, net in a market-risk exposure row was marked annual although it is a balance exposure.
Total deferred revenues under the May 31 comparative balance table was marked annual although it is an ending balance.
business_failure.root_cause: R8 made period_role complete but still fell back from a bare fiscal-year column to the 10-K annual duration before recognizing the table's comparative as-of axis or a row-level opening/balance exposure.
business_failure.meaning: A complete enum is not enough: mixing balances with annual flows would let retrieval and the model compare stock and flow numbers as if they shared the same time basis.

decision_zh: R3 的 93 对象与 15 mutation 工程证明保留，但逐条业务审计发现四个 ORCL 时点余额被误标年度流量，因此撤销其下游 authority。下一 Attempt 只增加通用的财务行语义和表级 presentation-axis 判定，重跑三案对象、clean proof 与六案 manifest；若再出现新的时间坐标 L1，则停止字段补丁并升级时间坐标 schema。
known_boundary: This is a deterministic financial-time-semantics defect found after fake materialization and before any real embedding or index write. It is not a BGE, Milvus, DeepSeek, ranking, source or external-search failure.
